g.text: Editors have held up better than readers in most editions

g.text: 12-month averages, Apr 2019-Mar 2020 = 100. By early 2026 editors are above views in 8 of 11 editions (descriptive; the H6 test found no AI Overviews effect)

g.text: Data: Wikimedia clickstream, pageviews and editor statistics (CC0). Editors: AQS, bots excluded; anonymous editors left out (temporary accounts from 2025-06); pt registered editors jump when IP editing ended (2020-10).
